h: Gosport, a short hop over the harbour
p: Gosport High Street runs right down to the waterfront, where the little Gosport Ferry crosses to Portsmouth in a matter of minutes. That means you can easily pair a visit here with a day out over at Gunwharf Quays or the Historic Dockyard on the other side.

On the Gosport side itself, the Royal Navy Submarine Museum is the big attraction, where you can go aboard HMS Alliance, and Explosion, the naval firepower museum, is up at Priddy's Hard. Falkland Gardens by the ferry is a nice spot for a sit down and a view of the Spinnaker Tower across the water.
Regency is strictly 18+, so this one is for grown-ups only.
